description: This file defines the ShippingQuote class, which models a shipping quote including options, costs, and error handling in the ordering system.

classes.name: ShippingQuote
classes.description: Models a shipping quote, including options, costs, return codes, and error information.

methods.name: setShippingOptions
methods.description: Sets the list of available shipping options.

methods.name: getShippingOptions
methods.description: Returns the list of available shipping options.

methods.name: setShippingModuleCode
methods.description: Sets the code identifying the shipping module used.

methods.name: setShippingReturnCode
methods.description: Sets the return code indicating the status of the shipping quote.

methods.name: setFreeShipping
methods.description: Sets whether the shipping is free.

methods.name: isFreeShipping
methods.description: Returns whether the shipping is free.

methods.name: setFreeShippingAmount
methods.description: Sets the amount for free shipping eligibility.

methods.name: getFreeShippingAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount threshold for free shipping.

methods.name: setHandlingFees
methods.description: Sets the handling fees for the shipping.

methods.name: setApplyTaxOnShipping
methods.description: Indicates whether tax is applied on shipping.

methods.name: isApplyTaxOnShipping
methods.description: Returns whether tax is applied on shipping.

methods.name: setSelectedShippingOption
methods.description: Selects a shipping option for the quote.

methods.name: setQuoteError
methods.description: Sets an error message related to the shipping quote.
